brand.name: Apoyo Food
brand.tagline: Food made by independent creators in Trinidad & Tobago.

translation.heading: Order-thread translation
translation.note: Computed once at send time and stored on the message — never recomputed on read. If the translate service is down, the original is delivered unchanged.
translation.serviceDown: Translate service unreachable when this was written — showing the original, which is the intended degrade, not an error.

home.title: Discover
home.intro: Home cooks, bakers, dessert makers and caterers near you — meals by pre-order, weekend specials, party trays and holiday menus.
home.freshTodayNote: The Fresh Today board arrives in Slice 9; the full-screen viewer in Slice 11.

browse.title: Browse
browse.body: The meals grid, filter sheets and sort arrive in Slice 9.

sellers.title: Sellers
sellers.body: The seller directory and the illustrated Trinidad region map arrive in Slice 9.

category.title: Category
category.body: Category landing pages arrive in Slice 9, once the taxonomy is seeded.

meal.title: Meal
meal.body: Listing detail — gallery, availability, seller card and the Request order CTA — arrives in Slice 10.

sellerProfile.title: Seller profile
sellerProfile.body: Cover, bio, areas, Menu shelf and Follow arrive in Slice 11.

search.title: Search
search.body: Search across meals and sellers arrives in Slice 9, with demand-event logging from the same slice.

saved.title: Saved
saved.body: Saved meals arrive in Slice 10; named collections in Phase 4.

orders.title: My orders
orders.body: Order history and the order thread arrive in Slices 17 and 18.

account.title: Account
account.body: Account settings arrive with the shared identity wiring in Slice 3.

login.title: Sign in
login.body: Sign-in posts to the central issuer (portal-web) — wired in Slice 3. Browsing never requires an account; you are only asked to sign in when you commit to something.

register.title: Create an account
register.body: Registration posts to the central issuer (portal-web) — wired in Slice 3.

dashboard.title: Seller dashboard
dashboard.body: Your order inbox, listings, Fresh Today posts and profile will live here. Onboarding arrives in Slice 13, listings in Slice 14, Fresh Today tools in Slice 15.

admin.title: Food administration
admin.body: The seller approval queue, listing takedowns, report intake and the category manager arrive in Slice 16, composed into the shared Apoyo admin shell.

login.title: Seller sign-in
login.body: Sellers sign in with the same ecosystem account — wired in Slice 3.

scaffold.heading: Slice 1 scaffold
scaffold.note: This page and the token proof below are scaffolding with a scheduled death — Slice 7 deletes both when the real Sobremesa component library lands.
scaffold.vividNote: Ink on green/teal/terracotta-vivid measures 3.10–3.80:1 — large or bold text and icons only. gold-vivid (6.55:1) is safe at any size, which is why it carries the status chips.
